:::{#exm-relative-change-stopping-criterion}
#### Stopping a descent on $f(x) = x^2 + 1$

Run [gradient descent](#def-gradient-descent) from $\iterpoint{x}{0} = 2$ with [step length](#def-gradient-descent) $\steplen = 0.25$, and stop at tolerance $\epsilon = 0.01$.
Each step [maps](functions.qmd#def-function) $x$ to $x - 0.25 \cdot 2x = x/2$:

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

### R

```{r}
#| label: relative-change-r
#| code-fold: false
x_rc <- 2
tol_rc <- 0.01
for (t_rc in 0:100) {
  x_next_rc <- x_rc - 0.25 * 2 * x_rc
  cost_rc <- x_rc^2 + 1
  cost_next_rc <- x_next_rc^2 + 1
  diff_rc <- cost_next_rc - cost_rc
  change_rc <- abs(diff_rc) / cost_rc
  below_tol_rc <- change_rc < tol_rc
  if (below_tol_rc) break
  x_rc <- x_next_rc
}
c(t = t_rc, change = change_rc)
```

### Python

```{python}
#| label: relative-change-python
#| code-fold: false
f_rc = lambda x: x**2 + 1
x_rc, tol_rc = 2.0, 0.01
for t_rc in range(101):
    x_next_rc = x_rc - 0.25 * 2 * x_rc
    change_rc = abs(f_rc(x_next_rc) - f_rc(x_rc)) / abs(f_rc(x_rc))
    if change_rc < tol_rc:
        break
    x_rc = x_next_rc
print(t_rc, change_rc);
```

:::

The criterion first holds at $t = $ `r t_rc`, where the relative change is `r signif(change_rc, 3)`.

<!-- no-figure: one stopping time -->

:::
